correctness.rationale: The generating-product recurrence is exact for all indices. Four modulo-two adjacent-pair states, one absorbing, yield an explicit three-state count matrix. The invariant x_m-z_m=1 proves the second-order recurrence and rational generating function; a simple pole supplies a strictly positive leading constant with spectral root between 2 and b. The cap-b comparison follows from the two distinct quadratic equations, and the b=2 endpoint telescopes. Exact integer product expansion independently corroborated the automaton and level counts for bases 3..9, plus the base-two formula.

value.rationale: The theorem solves the complete exact parity support on all base-power intervals for every radix at the first digit cap above hyper-ary partitions, a motivated arithmetic refinement of the Calkin--Wilf family. Its nontrivial quadratic spectral law proves a qualitative reversal: more allowed copies yield weakly larger partition counts but a strictly smaller parity-support exponent, a structural effect absent from pointwise growth results. The infinite classification and comparison go beyond finite examples or arbitrary parameter slices.
